title: Projective plane of order 12
statement: Find a projective plane of order 12: 157 points and 157 lines, each line holding 13 points, such that every two points lie on exactly one line. Planes are known for every prime-power order; order 6 is impossible (Bruck and Ryser 1949) and order 10 was ruled out by computer (Lam, Thiel and Swiercz 1989), so 12 is the smallest open order. A valid plane scores 1.
submission: Text file: 157 lines of text, each with the 13 points (numbered 0..156 or 1..157) of one line of the plane, separated by spaces or commas.
score: 1 for a projective plane of order 12; none is known, so the best known value is 0

best_known.source: no projective plane of order 12 is known: OEIS A001231 (number of projective planes of order n) lists values only through n = 10; read 9 Nov 2026
